main.description: A user's pronoun preferences, stored as an ordered array of pronoun sets.

sets.description: Ordered array of pronoun sets. First entry is primary. Maximum 10.

displayMode.description: Author's preferred display mode for their pronouns. If absent or unrecognized, clients MUST treat as 'all'.

createdAt.description: Set once on initial creation. Never modified on subsequent edits.

updatedAt.description: Set on every edit after initial creation. Absent on first write.

pronounSet.description: A single pronoun set, stored as an open-ended array of forms exactly as the user entered them.

forms.description: Pronoun forms in the order the user provided them. Conventionally forms[0] is subject and forms[1] is object, but clients MUST NOT assume a fixed number of forms. Display by joining with '/'.
